mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupons ( user_id, coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_amount, expire_time, status, order_id, use_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{couponId}, #{couponName}, #{couponAmount}, #{expireTime}, #{status}, #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, coupon_id AS couponId, coupon_name AS couponName, coupon_amount AS couponAmount, expire_time AS expireTime, status, order_id AS orderId, use_time AS useTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user_coupons WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
